## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated (behaviour-focused, including failure and authorization cases)
- [ ] Lint, format, and the full local test run are green
- [ ] Input validated; errors handled via the shared mechanism
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data added to code, config, or logs
- [ ] Database migration is new (never edits an applied one) and backwards compatible
- [ ] Docs updated (README/runbook/OpenAPI) and an ADR added or updated if a decision changed
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (it becomes the squash commit)
